# Photo-library operations

## Select the exact scope

Read [status](../../../docs/STATUS.md), the current spine through the
[planning agreement](../../../docs/plans/README.md), the
[original-photo runbook](../../../docs/art/original-photos.md) and relevant
[likeness rules](../../../docs/art/likeness.md). Consult
[launcher help](../../../bin/help.cmd) before choosing a command. A runbook
example is not permission to write Production, reset a Sandbox or schedule
another milestone.

Identify the user-approved objective, photo IDs/domain, library root,
existing writers, profile and permitted actions. Artists use a separate
domain; Various is an intake/hold pool, not a person. Keep active source
folders and their contents; do not prune them as cleanup.

## Choose the operation

- Selected normal arrivals use `bin\library.cmd`; they are not a full
  rebase. Housekeeping/viewer refresh via `bin\people-gallery.cmd` does not
  perform matching; selected framing and action manifests have their own
  guarded launchers. Consult the runbook for actual side effects and
  whether each preview can write evidence.
- Preserve original bytes, content/ID bindings, retained preparation and
  existing locks/owner decisions. Review replacements, duplicates, holds,
  unsafe lineage and backups against the exact policy and source state;
  do not infer identity or move permission from a similarity score.
- Preview the selected scope and its destinations; only apply or settle
  actions when that exact mutation and root are authorized. Do not select
  a whole-library action merely because a single photo needs work.
- FULL, LEAN and FAST have different preparation, retained evidence and
  recovery characteristics. Never describe FAST pixels as prepared clean
  images or treat a receipt as human acceptance.

For a whole-library reset or reassessment use
[likeness-rebase](../likeness-rebase/SKILL.md); for a live or interrupted
Sandbox job use [long-run acceptance](../long-run-acceptance/SKILL.md). Preserve
failure receipts before supported recovery and verify the actual installed
Gallery/Overview/Review plus unresolved human decisions before reporting
completion.
